title: File access built from input (fortran) — review required
description: A fortran file operation builds its path from input: FILEs*=s*[a-zA-Z]. Traversal sequences escape the directory. This lexical rule flags the construction; the reviewer confirms confinement via an allowlist of names.
remediation: Confine with an allowlist of names or map input through an allowlist.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any input-built path matches.
